purpose: Use For use as a lubricant to prevent further irritation or to relieve dryness of the eye.
indications_and_usage: Uses for use as a lubricant to prevent further irritation to relieve dryness of the eye
warnings: Warnngs For external use only Do not use ■ if this product changes color or becomes cloudy ■ if seal is broken or punctured When using this product ■ do not touch tip of container to any surface to avoid contamination ■ replace cap after each use Stop use and consult a physician if you experience any of the following ■ eye pain ■ changes in vision ■ irritation or redness for longer than 72 hours If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use. Do not use if this product changes color or becomes cloudy if you are sensitive to any ingredient in this product When using this product do not touch the tip of container to any surface to avoid contamination replace cap after each use Stop use and consult a physician if you experience any of the following: eye pain changes in vision occur irritation or redness for longer than 72 hours Keep out of reach of children If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away If pregnant or breastfeeding ask a health professional before use.
